title: Ground Stops, Grudges, and a Very Angry Power Bank
summary: A nationwide ground stop — only the second since 9/11 — shows just how fragile America's air traffic system really is. Plus, American doubles down on LAX, Alaska threads a single 737 across the Pacific to Tokyo, Singapore Airlines can't shake its yellow seat problem, and KLM's former CEO becomes the reason his old airline had to file a police report.
